facts.business: Brady & Morris Engineering Company Limited is a subsidiary of W. H. Brady And Company Limited and manufactures material handling equipment, serving industries such as steel, cement, power, sugar, chemicals, paper, mining, water & sewage treatment, and defence.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company hopes to do better in the financial year 2026-27. Efforts are being made to improve productivity, revenue and profits.

key_risks: Inflation pressures and other factors affecting demand for our products
Increasing cost of Raw Material, transport and storage
Supplier and distributor relationships and retention of distribution channels
Competitive market conditions and new entrants to the market
Labour shortages and attrition of Key Staff
Compliance and regulatory pressure including changes to tax laws
facts.related_party_note: Approval sought for material related party transactions with W. H. Brady And Company Limited for borrowing monies and availing corporate guarantee during FY 2026-27 and onwards, for an aggregate value not exceeding Rs. 300 crores.
